name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) makes the box pickup happen; RespondedExistence(door_open, target_picked_up) adds the door-open condition stated by the task, and together they capture the goal.

texts: If the door is open, pick up the target box at some point
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> -1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> 11
(u2, target_picked_up, u1) -> 12
